parameters.jsCode:
// Map each job to the sheet's columns. Score fields are filled in Phase 3.
const today = $now.setZone('Europe/London').toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd');
return $input.all().map(i => ({ json: {
  job_id: i.json.job_id,
  date_found: today,
  source: i.json.source,
  title: i.json.title,
  company: i.json.company,
  location: i.json.location,
  salary: i.json.salary,
  url: i.json.url,
  score: i.json.score ?? '',
  matched_skills: (i.json.matched_skills ?? []).join(', '),
  missing_skills: (i.json.missing_skills ?? []).join(', '),
  reason: i.json.reason ?? '',
  status: 'New',
}}));

// Build one Claude Messages API request per job.
// Structured outputs (output_config.format) make the response match the schema.
const cfg = $('Search config').first().json;

const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `You are a recruitment screening assistant. You compare one job listing against one
candidate profile and return ONLY valid JSON, no prose, no code fences.

Scoring guide:
- 80–100: strong fit on core skills, level and location/remote
- 60–79: good fit with 1–2 learnable gaps
- 40–59: partial fit, several gaps
- 0–39: poor fit or wrong seniority/location

Rules:
- Judge only on the information given. Do not invent requirements.
- If salary is missing, do not penalise.
- Penalise roles requiring 5+ years in a specific tool, or people-management of large teams.
- Location: "Location check" was worked out by code. Use it as given. Never estimate distances
  or work patterns yourself. "ok" or "possible": do not reduce the score for location.
  "unknown": at most a small reduction. "probably too far": score at most 45.
  "too far": score at most 35. remote_or_local_ok is true only for "ok" or "possible".
- Prefer full-stack TypeScript/React/React Native, .NET/C#, and API/integration roles.
- Treat AI/automation work as a bonus, not a requirement.
- Penalise roles centred on Java, Python, Salesforce, embedded or industrial automation.
- matched_skills: skills that the listing asks for AND the profile lists. Nothing else.
- missing_skills: skills that the listing asks for and the profile does not list. Never add a skill
  the listing does not mention, even if it is under NOT LEARNED.
- A framework is separate from its language: C# or .NET does not cover ASP.NET or Blazor. But if the
  candidate knows the language, count a missing framework as a small learnable gap.
- matched_skills and missing_skills: up to 6 short strings each.
- reason: one sentence, max 25 words.`;

const SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    score: { type: 'integer', description: 'Match score 0-100' },
    matched_skills: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
    missing_skills: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
    seniority_fit: { type: 'string', enum: ['junior', 'mid', 'senior', 'unclear'] },
    remote_or_local_ok: { type: 'boolean' },
    reason: { type: 'string' },
  },
  required: ['score', 'matched_skills', 'missing_skills', 'seniority_fit', 'remote_or_local_ok', 'reason'],
  additionalProperties: false,
};

return $input.all().map(i => {
  const j = i.json;
  const userMessage = [
    'CANDIDATE PROFILE:',
    cfg.candidate_profile,
    '',
    'JOB LISTING:',
    `Title: ${j.title}`,
    `Company: ${j.company || 'Not stated'}`,
    `Location: ${j.location || 'Not stated'}`,
    `Salary: ${j.salary || 'Not stated'}`,
    `Location check: ${j.location_verdict ?? 'unknown'} (work pattern: ${j.work_mode ?? 'unclear'}; ${j.miles == null ? 'distance unknown' : j.miles + ' miles from home'})`,
    'Description:',
    String(j.description || 'Not provided').slice(0, 6000),
  ].join('\n');

  return { json: {
    ...j,
    claude_request: {
      model: cfg.model,
      max_tokens: 2000,
      system: SYSTEM_PROMPT,
      output_config: { effort: 'low', format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: SCHEMA } },
      messages: [{ role: 'user', content: userMessage }],
    },
  }};
});
